documents.text: in Altrincham , Greater Manchester , England . Admissions [ edit ] The school is a fully selective non-fee paying grammar school with admission via an entrance exam . Its previous status as a foundation school allowed for a degree of independence from the local education authority , until in 2011 , under the government 's education reforms , it attained Academy status .
